entities.summary: Richard José Hidalgo [ee-dahl'-go] is a Venezuelan former professional outfielder. He played with the Houston Astros (1997–2004), New York Mets (2004), and the Texas Rangers (2005) of Major League Baseball (MLB). He batted and threw right-handed.
